entities.summary: Carlos Rosa Mayi is a Dominican former professional baseball pitcher. He played in Major League Baseball (MLB) for the Kansas City Royals and Arizona Diamondbacks, and in Nippon Professional Baseball (NPB) for the Chiba Lotte Marines.
